findings.summary: Both browser test launchers force an executable path to CHROMIUM_PATH or /tmp/chromium, bypassing the established helper that otherwise uses Playwright-managed Chromium. The workflow installs managed Chromium but does not configure CHROMIUM_PATH; if /tmp/chromium is absent, launch fails before renderer assertions. This is a source/workflow portability finding, not an observed CI failure.
findings.required_resolution: Use the shared chromiumLaunchOptions helper in both launchers and validate through the fresh managed-browser CI run.
